== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Located on [[Mount Samara]], the Heaven's Glory{{!}}Heaven’s Glory School is a prestigious institution characterized by its impressive [[rainstone]] architecture. The school's buildings are sculpted from a glistening, expensive material that makes the structures appear as though they are perpetually wet or drenched in light. The campus features various facilities, including a three-story residence near the Ancestor's Tomb{{!}}Ancestor’s Tomb and a [[Lesser Treasure Hall]], which is marked by a large golden sign that gathers [[aura]] to remain visible at night. The school also utilizes gardens containing sacred herbs and trees, which are integrated into the various layers of its [[fortress]] to assist with [[aura]] [[cycling]]. The school is known for its strict adherence to honor and reputation, as its standing influences how other clans and even nomadic outsiders interact with it. Disciples are required to wear specific white and gold clothing with red sashes to indicate their rank, and they are subject to rigorous training. To become a [[disciple]], candidates must complete the [[Trial of Glorious Ascension]], a challenge involving a staircase equipped with [[Remnant]] formations. Those who complete the trial quickly may earn rewards from the school's treasure hall, which contains various weapons, [[elixirs]], and [[constructs]]. The institution maintains strict rules regarding the conduct of its members, specifically prohibiting disciples from killing one another. [[Heaven's Glory]] is also associated with the [[Jades]], a group of powerful members. The school has faced significant challenges, including being targeted by outsiders who sought to steal its [[sacred arts]] and suffering physical [[destruction]] that required costly repairs. The school has been involved in conflicts involving the [[Wei clan]], and its members have been known to pursue individuals they deem enemies with great persistence.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Located on [[Mount Samara]], the Heaven's Glory{{!}}Heaven’s Glory School is a riverstone-sculpted institution that utilizes Samara's ring{{!}}Samara’s ring to gather [[light aura]]. The school maintains a hierarchy of elders and lesser initiates, typically only accepting students who have reached the [[Iron stage]]. Members are identified by their white and gold uniforms with red sashes and Iron{{!}}iron badges, though the school has previously lost four disciples to an outsider seeking their [[sacred arts]]. While the elders prioritize cultivating only the strongest disciples, they strictly forbid members from killing one another. During recent events, [[Lindon]] attempted to trick his way into the school and engaged in combat with one of its elders, while the institution also came into possession of [[Yerin's master]]'s body, [[sword]], and [[Remnant]].}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Located near the eastern exit of [[Sacred Valley]], the Heaven's Glory{{!}}Heaven’s Glory School is an institution composed of smooth [[rainstone]] buildings that covers a large portion of the mountain. The school, which once held a coveted position for Wei Jin Amon{{!}}Amon, utilizes apprentices identified by wooden, Iron{{!}}iron, or copper badges and has historically gathered [[Ruler techniques]]. Although the school is willing to negotiate territory and possesses more influence than the [[Wei clan]], it is considered the most wisdom-challenged of the schools. After the school hunted [[Lindon]]'s family and surrounded the hill with plans to keep the [[Kazan]] prisoners, they eventually deactivated their formation. Following these events, [[Lindon]] claimed the school in the absence of its [[Jades]], despite having no prior attachment to the institution.}}
